case_number: 2025 INSC 134; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (C) No. 4194 of 2024 and 4195 of 2024)

parties.petitioner: Parimal Kumar & Ors.; Gurucharan Mahto & Ors.

summary: Dispute over teacher eligibility: JTET vs CTET/STET; NCTE guidelines allow state schools to consider TET certificates from other states or central government if state TET not conducted; High Court permitted CTET/STET holders to participate in Jharkhand recruitment due to nine-year gap in JTET; State's oral concession in court contradicted written affidavits; issue of legitimacy of oral concession and prejudice to JTET qualified candidates; interpretation of NCTE guidelines, particularly para 10 on applicability and relaxation of eligibility; ongoing recruitment for 13,000 Assistant Teacher posts under Advertisement No. 13/2023; standard for judicial review of administrative decisions based on inconsistency between pleadings and oral submissions.
legal_provisions_cited: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009 s.23(1)
final_judgment: To be determined based on full hearing; leave granted; matters listed for final disposal.
